This editable working starter follows the confirmed application-based seven-chapter structure in the local FYP Handbook T2610 and the M1 continuation pack. Current FYP2 rubric, template and submission instructions still need reconciliation. It is not a completed FYP2 report or final submission template. The existing FYP1 submission remains unchanged. StethoFuse is the product brand, not a replacement academic title. The confirmed production target is stethofuse.ashraf-alsaloul.com, not a claim of live deployment.

# Introduction

Develop the problem, objectives, scope, limitations, methodology and intended stakeholders using the submitted revision and the approved change record. Preserve the no-diagnosis boundary. Explain persistent multi-user recording management and the question of whether ensemble fusion helps; do not promise improvement.

# Literature Review

Retain original review provenance and separately log any new search. Reconcile exact candidate papers, code, licenses, checkpoints and domain suitability before claiming named reproductions. Distinguish baseline NMF/VMD from literature-faithful NMF/NMCF and the complete DAE-NMF-VMD pipeline. No performance values are supplied in this starter.

# Requirements Analysis

Preserve the original 53-response questionnaire and limitations. Version original F/NF/UR/UC identifiers and link the 52 continuation requirements without erasing the initial R01-R18 summaries. Separate original elicitation, implementation-driven revision and planned post-deployment feedback. Add identity, backend ownership/roles, persistent audio, explicit review, administration and one ensemble request through the traceability register. Any new target-user findings require genuine evidence.

# System Design

Document context, roles/trust boundaries, use cases, activities, components, domain model, protected storage, job lifecycle and authorized sequences. The separation design must resolve output compatibility, alignment, scale, residual handling, fusion and expert failure policy. Produce new diagrams without overwriting historical sources.

# Implementation

The pre-M1 foundations comprise a fictional frontend, a legacy FastAPI/SQLite individual-strategy workflow and a standalone access-control harness. M1 is integrating real authentication and protected application paths; its precise code/test status is maintained in the separate M1 implementation and test notes. Use implemented, integrated, tested, verified live, planned, simulated and blocked distinctly. Mocked identities do not prove real Firebase operation, and intended administrator email is not a UID or privilege rule. Synthetic audio, simulated jobs and candidate expert names do not establish real ensemble inference.

# Testing

Keep prior demo browser evidence dated and scoped. Add actual unit/API/system/persistence/access tests and controlled held-out individual-versus-ensemble evaluation when authorized and run. Record heart/lung measurements separately, dataset splits, reference mapping, runtime and negative findings. Physical device tests, target-user acceptance and deployment recovery remain evidence gates.

# Conclusion

Complete after implementation and test evidence is available. State achieved objectives, measured findings, limitations and remaining work without converting planned benefits into results.
